newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans end higher after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans end higher after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans rose to finish higher in tight trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with the local market following Chicago prices higher, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans closed up $3 at $273 for delivery to Rosario. Cash maize, buoyed by the rising soybeans and a shortage of sellers, rose $3 to end at $103 for delivery to Buenos Aires. Cash sunflower seed rose $2 to end at $219 for delivery to Rosario, with a shortrage of sellers.
